name: Manycore Tech
summary: Manycore Tech Inc. offers a cloud-based software-as-a-service platform with computer-aided design and modelling tools for residential, commercial and industrial spaces, in China and internationally. Its products include Kujiale, a cloud-native tool for 3D design, visualisation and project execution, Coohom, the international counterpart of Kujiale, and Modelo, a 3D-centred product.
